newsitem.title: GHANA: Ashanti, Mobil boost Ghana bourse.
newsitem.headline: Ashanti, Mobil boost Ghana bourse.

text.p: The Ghana bourse extended its gains on Wednesday, buoyed by surging Ashanti Goldfileds Co Ltd and Mobil Oil Ghana Ltd, traders said.
The Ghana Stock Exchange All-Share index climbed 1.56 points to 357.62 points. Five stocks appreciated against two decliners.
Continuing a recent trend, bids far outstripped offers by 2,217,460 to 874,290. Volume at 54,490 shares traded was more than double the 27,120 recorded in last trading on Monday.

Ashanti led gainers, jumping 190 cedis to 21,100 cedis. Mobil gained 100 cedis to 5,100 cedis while trading groups Paterson Zochonis and Unilever respectively added 15 cedis to 315 and six cedis to 755. Another recent star, Ghana Commercial Bank went up five cedis to 660 cedis.
The losers were Pioneer Aluminium Factory, down by five cedis to 165 cedis, and UTC Estates, five cedis lower to 50 cedis.
